title: Opposition MPs rally outside Belgrade police station for detained TV owner
seoTitle: Belgrade rally for detained TV owner

tea.why: Opposition MPs and supporters gathered to protest the detention of Informer TV owner Dragan J. Vucicevic by the public prosecutor's office.
tea.want: The release of the detained TV owner.
tea.changed: Nov 25: The crowd dispersed before 1 pm after announcing a press conference for 7 pm.

summary: On November 25, 2026, members of the "Srbija pobjeđuje" parliamentary group walked out of the National Assembly of Serbia to protest outside the Vozdovac police station in Belgrade. The protest followed the detention of Dragan J. Vucicevic, the owner of Informer TV, who was taken into custody by order of the Second Basic Public Prosecutor's Office on suspicion of extended incitement to panic and disorder, as well as obstruction of justice. Participants included opposition lawmakers, Informer staff, and other public figures. Aleksandar Vucic, head of the parliamentary group, stated that the detention was related to the owner's journalistic work. The crowd dispersed shortly before 1 pm, with plans for a later press conference at the same location.
response: The Second Basic Public Prosecutor's Office ordered a 48-hour detention for the suspect, citing suspicion of extended incitement to panic and disorder and obstruction of justice.

updates.text: Opposition MPs walk out of parliament and gather outside the Vozdovac police station to protest the detention of the Informer TV owner.
The crowd disperses before 1 pm, with organizers announcing a press conference scheduled for 7 pm at the same location.
